candidate: Only one: original legal M3 A/B INIT at signal CLOSE requires known KVO_histogram > 0; UNKNOWN preserves original decision and is separate, never claimed as indicator pass.
consumer: Preserve original PVR order and original industry top2 selected identities. Report gating of original selected tickets only; no third-rank refill or new reservation. Raw all-AB rows descriptive, no invented held/flat state. No effect on ADD/exits/reentry/risk limits.

periods.source: Klinger1997 public defaults, not user-selected or tuned

series: S=raw_high+raw_low+raw_close; DM=raw_high-raw_low; V=raw_volume in shares, NOT amount or price-adjusted volume.
trend: T=+1 if S rises, -1 if S falls, previous T on equality. Chosen original textual tenet/current TA-Lib; NOT original Excel IF <= branch. Exact float comparison, no fuzzy threshold.
cm: At first valid anchor a keep S_a,DM_a,T_a=+1 only. At a+1 CM=DM_a+DM_a+1. Thereafter CM=DMprev+DM on T change else CMprev+DM.
vf: If CM==0, VF=0; else VF=V*abs(2*(DM/CM)-1)*T*100. Do not use abs(2*(DM/CM-1)). H=L is valid; if CM>0 use original formula, no invented flat-bar zero.
ema: At first VF (a+1), F=Slow=VF, K=F-Slow=0, Signal=0. Thereafter F=alpha34*VF+(1-alpha34)*Fprev; Slow analogous55; Signal=alpha13*K+(1-alpha13)*Signalprev; alphaN=2/(N+1). histogram=K-Signal. Full causal segment prefix, never rolling re-anchor at each signal.
warmup: Known only at >=111 consecutive valid common-calendar rows including anchor (>=110 VF observations), reflecting original article more-than110-row warning. Explicit research computability boundary, not universally standard TA-Lib lookback and not a guarantee of zero seed sensitivity. No alternate warmup test.
breaks: Any missing common-calendar observation, invalid source/flags/units/price/volume, source_kind/source_path/segment_id change, adjustment_factor change, or volume_factor change ends old state. Next valid row anchors new segment; UNKNOWN until111 rows. No carry across an unknown break, no price factor reused as volume factor.
validity: Observed_bar,is_observed_bar,price_eligible,volume_eligible true; source_invalid,synthetic_event_bar false; nonempty known source_kind/path/segment_id; finite positive raw OHLC and native OHLC, valid high/low bounds; positive finite raw_volume,amount,adjustment_factor,volume_factor; shares/CNY units; native OHLC approx raw*pricefactor abs<=1e-8; amount/shares within raw low/high allowing 0.5/share+1e-8. V remains raw shares.
clock: Only rows <= signal CLOSE enter every indicator; earliest execution next common trading OPEN under original OPEN proxy. No minute data, no OPEN HLCV, no future closes. Historical prepared data lack complete historical publication/revision known_at: reproducible current-vintage causal prefix, NON-PIT universe/source/sector caveat remains.
stops: No account/fills/returns construction, no training/parametergrid/second formula. Original actual labels may attach after feature seal only, for controls; refused or context-only names never inherit independent PnL.
